battleTraits.name: Skyvessel Cover
battleTraits.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly **^^Kharadron Overlords Infantry^^** units that have not charged in the same turn while they are wholly within 6" of a friendly **Arkanaut Ironclad** or **Arkanaut Frigate** that has not charged in the same turn.

battleTraits.name: Flying High
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Skyvessel^^** that is in a regiment from which no units have been deployed, then pick a number of units up to its Transport Capacity (see its warscroll) that are in its regiment.
battleTraits.effect: Set up all of those units in reserve **in the clouds**. They have now been deployed.

battleTraits.name: Descend from the Clouds
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Skyvessel^^** **in the clouds** to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: Set up that **^^Skyvessel^^** anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up all other units that were set up **in the clouds** with that **^^Skyvessel^^** wholly within 6" of it and more than 9" from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Transport Skyfarers
battleTraits.effect: Pick a number of units up to that **^^Skyvessel^^**’s Transport Capacity (see its warscroll) that are wholly within 6" of it and not in combat to be the targets. Units that have been transported this turn cannot be targets. Remove the targets from the battlefield. After the **^^Skyvessel^^** ends its move, you must set up each target unit on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of that **^^Skyvessel^^** and not in combat. Those units have been transported. A unit cannot use **^^Charge^^** abilities if it was transported in the same turn.

battleTraits.name: The Flagship
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Skyvessel^^** to be the target. The target can be in reserve.
battleTraits.effect: The target has the **^^Flagship^^** keyword for the rest of the battle. If the target does not have a Great Endrinwork, give the target 1 Great Endrinwork. **Designer's Note:** *This Great Endrinwork is given to the unit during the deployment phase not during army composition.*

abilities.name: Aetheric Augmentation
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **Arkanaut Company** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s ranged weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Atmospheric Isolation
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from charge rolls for enemy units within 9" of this unit.

abilities.name: Read the Winds
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Skyvessel^^** or **^^Auto-Endrin^^** within this unit's combat range and that is not in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, if the target is a **^^Skyvessel^^**, you can remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of the target and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Aethersight
abilities.effect: This unit can use **^^Unbind^^** abilities as if it had **^^Wizard (1)^^**.

units.name: Anvil of Apotheosis: Kharadron Overlords Hero

abilities.name: Spell Breaker
abilities.effect: This unit can use **^^Unbind^^** abilities as if it has **^^Wizard (1)^^**.

abilities.name: Backup Thruster-endrins
abilities.effect: This unit cannot be picked to be the target of enemy **^^Rampage^^** abilities.

abilities.name: Figurehead Battering Ram
abilities.timing: Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target, then roll a dice.
abilities.effect: On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Custom Aetherburner
abilities.timing: End of Your Turn
abilities.effect: This unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units that were in combat with it at the start of the move, but not those of other enemy units. It cannot end the move in combat.

abilities.name: Solitary Pioneer
abilities.effect: While this unit is contesting an objective that is not being contested by any other friendly units, add 8 to this unit's control score.

abilities.name: Old Skybeard
abilities.effect: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **^^Skyvessels^^** while they are within 3" of this unit.

abilities.name: Loyalty Bought
abilities.effect: While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly **Arkanaut Company** unit: • This unit has **^^Ward (4+)^^**. • Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly **Arkanaut Company** unit within its combat range after the damage sequence has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

abilities.name: Master of Ballistics
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared a **^^Shoot^^** ability for a unit within 3" of this unit
abilities.effect: You can re-roll hit rolls of 1 for the attacks made as part of that **^^Shoot^^** ability.

abilities.name: Slow and Steady
abilities.effect: While this unit is in combat with an enemy unit that is also in combat with another friendly unit, this unit has **^^Strike-last^^**.

abilities.name: Bad Luck Charm
abilities.effect: This unit cannot be picked to be a target of the 'Transport Skyfarers' ability.

abilities.name: Piratical Tendencies
abilities.effect: While this unit is in combat with an enemy unit that has an enhancement, all attacks made by this unit must target that enemy unit.

abilities.name: Glass Eye
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for this unit's shooting attacks.

abilities.name: Hasty Repairist
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Skyvessel^^** or **Zontari Endrin Dock** within this unit's combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: **Heal (D3)** the target.

abilities.name: Spell-bottler
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Manifestation^^** in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 3D6. If the roll is equal to or highter than the target's banishment value, it is automatically destroyed and, for the rest of the battle, your opponent and their units cannot use abilities that would summon that **^^Manifestation^^**

abilities.name: Nullstone-studded Armour
abilities.effect: Enemy **^^Manifestations^^** have **^^Strike-last^^** while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: A Company Duardin
abilities.timing: Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it by this unit's attacks this phase to be the target.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for shooting attacks made by friendly **^^Skyfarer^^** units that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: The Admiral's Flagship
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Flagship^^** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the phase, each time the target uses a **^^Shoot^^** ability, you can re-roll 1 of the hit rolls made for that ability.

abilities.name: 'Bring Every Gun to Bear!'
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **Skyvessel** wholly within 24" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s ranged weapons.

abilities.name: Grizzled Buccaneers
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+: • This unit can immediately use a **^^Shoot^^** ability as if it were your shooting phase but all of its attacks must target the target enemy unit. • For the rest of the phase, this unit's **Privateer Heavy Weapons** have **Shoot in Combat**.

abilities.name: Assault Boat
abilities.timing: Your Charge Phase
abilities.declare: This unit cannot use this ability if it is in combat or has used a **^^Run^^** or **^^Retreat^^** ability this turn. Pick a number of units up to its Transport Capacity that are wholly within 6" of it, are not in combat and that have not charged this turn to be the targets. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: This unit can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll and must end the move within 1/2" of a visible enemy unit. If it does so: • Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within this unit’s combat range. The targets can be set up in combat. • This unit and the targets have charged, and the targets cannot use another **^^Core^^** ability this phase. • Pick up to 1 of the targets to have **^^Strike-first^^** for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Heavy Sky Ordnance** is 3.

abilities.name: Medium Bomb Racks
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that does not have **^^Fly^^** and that this unit passed across this phase to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 6 dice. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Transport Capacity
abilities.effect: This unit can transport up to 2 friendly **^^Kharadron Overlords Infantry^^** units with a combined model count of up to 12 (see Battle Traits).

abilities.name: Incoming!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Incoming!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Great Sky Ordnance** is 4.

abilities.name: Heavy Bomb Racks
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that does not have **^^Fly^^** and that this unit passed across this phase to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 10 dice. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Transport Capacity
abilities.effect: This unit can transport up to 3 friendly **^^Kharadron Overlords Infantry^^** units with a combined model count of up to 22 (see Battle Traits).

abilities.name: Nullifier Auto-Endrin
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is a **Nullifier Auto-Endrin** and is in combat with any enemy **^^Manifestations^^**, pick each enemy **^^Manifestation^^** in combat with it to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Make a **banishment roll** of 3D6 for each target. If the banishment roll equals or exceeds the **banishment value** on the **^^Manifestation^^**'s warscroll, it is banished and removed from play. Then, remove this unit from the battlefield.

abilities.name: Expendable Munitions
abilities.effect: The following apply to this unit: • This unit has a maximum control score of '-'. • When this unit is destroyed or removed from the battlefield, it does not count as being destroyed for the purposes of other rules (such as scoring battle tactics). • This unit cannot be picked to be the target of or be affected by any non-**^^Core^^** abilities used by other friendly units unless the ability specifies **^^Auto-Endrin^^** • Ignore this unit for the purposes of friendly and enemy battle tactics.

abilities.name: Stuncloud Auto-Endrin
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is a **Stuncloud Auto-Endrin** and is in combat, pick each enemy unit in combat with it to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. If the roll is equal to or lower than that target's Health characteristic, subtract 10 from the control score of that target for the rest of the turn. Then, remove this unit from the battlefield.

abilities.name: Grudgeblast Auto-Endrin
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is a **Grudgeblast Auto-Endrin** and is in combat, pick each enemy unit in combat with it to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, remove this unit from the battlefield.

abilities.name: Command the Fleet
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly **^^Skyvessels^^** wholly within 24" of this unit that are not in combat to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Each target can use a **^^Run^^** ability and still use **^^Shoot^^** and/or **^^Charge^^** abilities later in the turn.

abilities.name: First Rule of Grungsson
abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 2 other friendly **^^Skyfarer^^** units within this unit’s combat range to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets’ melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Moustache-mounted Aetherblasters
abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Advisory Role
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly **^^Skyfarers^^** units to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply to that target for the rest of the turn: ***Seek New Prospects:*** Add 5 to the target’s control score. ***Don’t Argue With the Wind:*** Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for the target. ***There’s No Trading With Some People:*** The target can use a **^^Retreat^^** ability and still use **^^Shoot^^** abilities later in the turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on the target by **^^Retreat^^** abilities.

abilities.name: I'm Watching You
abilities.timing: Any Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Give this unit D3 **vexed points**.

abilities.name: Alright, Listen Up
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly non-**^^Hero Kharadron Overlords^^** unit, pick a visible enemy unit wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target. Then, choose to spend either 3 or 6 **vexed points**.
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of the following effects to apply to the target for the rest of the turn: • ***Do you see how fast they are going?!:*** If you spent 3 **vexed points**, subtract D3 from the target's Move characteristic. If you spent 6 **vexed points**, halve the target's Move characteristic. • ***Those weapons are against regulation!:*** If you spent 3 **vexed points**, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target's combat attacks. If you spent 6 **vexed points**, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of the target's melee weapons and subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target's combat attacks.

abilities.name: Captain of the Aelsling
abilities.timing: Deployment Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an **Arkanaut Frigate** in this unit’s regiment to be the target. This unit can use this ability while in reserve, and the target can also be in reserve.
abilities.effect: The target has the **^^Aelsling^^** keyword. Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target’s **Boarding Weapons** for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Auxiliary Skyhook
abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Monster^^** in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+: • Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. • Subtract 1 from wound rolls made for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: She Can Handle It!
abilities.effect: You can re-roll run rolls and charge rolls for the **^^Aelsling^^** while it is wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Combat Engineers
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit and up to 1 friendly **Endrinriggers** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, combat attacks made by the targets against enemy units that charged this turn have **Crit (2 Hits)**.

abilities.name: Mobile Repairs
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Skyvessel^^** or **Zontari Endrin Dock** within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, **Heal (3)** the target.

abilities.name: 'Aye Aye, Captain!'
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Skyvessel^^** within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn: • The target can use a **^^Retreat^^** or **^^Run^^** ability and still use **^^Shoot^^** abilities later in the turn. • No mortal damage is inflicted on the target by **^^Retreat^^** abilities.

abilities.name: Mobile Repairs
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Skyvessel^^** or **Zontari Endrin Dock** within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, **Heal (3)** the target.

abilities.name: Emergency Field Repairs
abilities.timing: End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Skyvessel^^** or **Zontari Endrin Dock** within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: Make a field repairs roll of D6 for each model in this unit. For each 4-5, **Heal (1)** the target. For each 6, **Heal (2)** the target.

abilities.name: We're Working Here
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, if this unit has not charged in the same turn, the following cumulative effects apply depending on your **fury level**. **1+ *Irked*:** This unit’s **Aethermatic Saws** have **Crit (Auto-wound)**. **4+ *Exasperated*:** This unit has Ward (5+). **7 *Incensed*:** Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.

abilities.name: Long-line Slings
abilities.effect: When you use the 'Transport Skyfarers' ability for this unit, you can pick units in combat to be targets.

abilities.name: Light Bomb Racks
abilities.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that does not have **^^Fly^^** and that this unit passed across this phase to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 4 dice. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Transport Capacity
abilities.effect: This unit can transport 1 friendly **^^Kharadron Overlords Infantry^^** units with a model count of up to 5 (see Battle Traits).

abilities.name: Aethershot Overwatch
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Attack Squadron
abilities.effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of any other friendly **Grundstok Gunhaulers**, it can use **^^Shoot^^** abilities even if it used the 'Run' ability in the same turn.

abilities.name: Fighter Vessels
abilities.timing: Any Shooting Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit used a **^^Shoot^^** ability this phase, this unit can move D6". It cannot end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Transport Capacity
abilities.effect: This unit cannot transport any friendly units.

abilities.name: Specialist Grundstok Ammunition
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase, Reaction: You declared a **^^Shoot^^** ability for this unit
abilities.declare: Pick **Shieldbreaker** ammunition or **Thunderdrakk** ammunition.
abilities.effect: If all of the attacks made for that **^^Shoot^^** ability target the same enemy unit, after that **^^Shoot^^** ability has been resolved, roll a dice and add the number of damage points allocated to the target by that **^^Shoot^^** ability. If the roll is higher than the target's Control characteristic, apply the following effect to the target based on the ammunition type picked: ***Shieldbreaker:*** Ward rolls cannot be made for the target until the start of your next turn. ***Thunderdrakk:*** That target has a maximum control score of 1 until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Protection of the Void
abilities.effect: While they are wholly within 12" of this unit, friendly **^^Skyfarer^^** units have **^^Ward (5+)^^** against mortal damage inflicted by **^^Spell^^** abilities, **^^Prayer^^** abilities and abilities used by **^^Manifestations^^**.

abilities.name: Nullsuit
abilities.effect: Double the Damage characteristic of this unit's weapons for attacks that target **^^Priests^^**, **^^Wizards^^**, or **^^Manifestations^^**.

abilities.name: Diligent Researcher
abilities.effect: Each time your opponent spends any rage dice as part of the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability, after that ability has been resolved, if this unit is not in combat, it can move up to **X**D6", where **X** is the number of rage dice spent. It cannot end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Customised Nullsuit
abilities.effect: • This unit can use **^^Unbind^^** and **^^Banish^^** abilities as if it had **^^Wizard (1)^^**. • Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making unbinding rolls and banishment rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.

abilities.name: Timed Charges
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+: • Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. • This unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.

abilities.name: Aethermatic Anatomiser
abilities.timing: Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit’s **Bjorgen Thundrik** is on the battlefield, pick an objective within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+: • If the target is controlled by either player, that player loses control of that objective. • The target cannot be contested until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Light Endrinpacks
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is in combat, it can move 2D6" but must end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Spotter's Flaregun
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an objective within 9" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the following effects for the rest of the turn: • Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **^^Skyfarer^^** units that target a unit that is contesting the target objective. • Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **Vongrim Salvagers** and **Vongrim Harpoon Crew** units for attacks that target a unit that is contesting the target objective

abilities.name: Repair Routines
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Skyvessel^^** within 3" of this terrain feature to be the target.
abilities.effect: Make a repair roll of D6. Add 1 to the roll if there is a friendly **Endrinmaster with Dirigible Suit** or **Endrinmaster with Endrinharness** within 3" of this terrain feature. On a 4+, **Heal (3)** the target.

abilities.name: Release the Auto-Endrins
abilities.timing: Deployment Phase
abilities.effect: Set up a friendly **Nullifier Auto-Endrin**, **Stuncloud Auto-Endrin** and **Grudgeblast Auto-Endrin** (see the Auto-Endrin warscroll) on the battlefield within friendly territory, wholly within 6" of this terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Endrinworks Outpost
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Auto-Endrin^^** or replacement **^^Auto-Endrin^^** that has been removed from the battlefield to be the target.
abilities.effect: Make a manufacturing roll of D6. Add 1 to the roll if there is a friendly **Endrinmaster with Dirigible Suit** or **Endrinmaster with Endrinharness** within 3" of this terrain feature. On a 4+, set up a replacement **^^Auto-Endrin^^** on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of this terrain feature and more than 3" from all enemy units.
